data.name: Ajahar
data.gender_notes: Ajahar is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Ajahar is derived from the Sanskrit language and translates to 'conqueror' or 'victorious'. In Hindu mythology, this name is associated with the gods Indra and Vishnu, who are known for their bravery and power. The name Ajahar carries the meaning “Conqueror, Victorious” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Ajahar usually hope their child will grow to embody conqueror, victorious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Embodying the strength and courage of Indra and Vishnu, the name Ajahar inspires one to conquer personal challenges and obstacles with determination and wisdom.
data.etymology: Ajahar belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Conqueror, Victorious.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ajahar total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

These deities are revered for their strength and courage, and the name Ajahar serves as a reminder of their divine power and influence. It also reflects the Hindu belief in the importance of victory and success in life, as well as the value of bravery and courage.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Ajahar carries deep spiritual significance for Hindus as it symbolizes the triumph of good over evil and the victory of the true self over the material world. It reminds us of the power of truth and dharma and encourages us to strive for spiritual growth and enlightenment. The name also evokes feelings of courage, strength, and determination, and inspires us to conquor our fears, weaknesses, and negative emotions. Ultimately, Ajahar is a powerful reminder of the divine potential within us all and the strength we possess to overcome any challenge or obstacle that comes our way.
